concerns.text: The plan asserts that the entire experimental pipeline (30 seeds × 5 conditions ≈ 150 training runs, each ≤3 epochs) will complete within a single GitHub Actions CI job limited to 6 hours wall‑clock (see Phase 0–9 and the “≤6 h wall‑clock” claim). Running TinyLlama‑1.1B (even 8‑bit quantized) on a CPU‑only runner for this many runs is highly unlikely to finish within 6 hours, making the compute feasibility claim unrealistic.

The research description states that all heavy operations (SVD, training) are designed to run on the free CPU‑only runner. Layer‑wise randomized SVD on a 1.1 B‑parameter model and 30‑seed training loops will likely exceed the 7 GB RAM limit or cause excessive runtime, violating FR‑007 and FR‑012.
